steps.comment: The first document counts in twos: every number in it is half a point, exactly as a Retina capture's are.

A plate and a smaller box on it. Two things, because a group needs two: one layer on its own cannot be grouped, and only a group can be made into a component. Both are shapes, so the group has no smallest height of its own and the exact numbers below are taken as typed.

Exact numbers on the group itself, so what arrives in the second document can be checked against something rather than eyeballed. W and H live in the Position and Size popout, so it has to be open before anything can be typed into them.
Put the popout away before the component is made: it sits over the panel, and the name field a new component opens for is in the panel underneath it.

steps.note: the first document counts in twos: the button reads 240 by 80 here, which is 120 by 40 of the points a person sees

steps.comment: A brand new document that counts one to one, the file you start from scratch.
THE TEST. A document counting in ones holds it at 120 by 40: the same button, the same size on screen, restated in this document's unit. Before this it arrived at 240 by 80 and drew twice as big.

steps.note: the second document counts one to one: the same button reads 120 by 40 and is the same size on screen as it was in the first
